earlier_scan.source_named: Kedrebeogo, Gerard 1984. Description phonologique du samoma (parler de Loroni). MA thesis, Sorbonne Nouvelle; also his 1989 Ouagadougou dissertation and 1997 'Tone in Samoma'

sources.citation: Tirogo, Issoufou François & Noéllie Soubeiga. 2023. Vowel length in Kasim, Samoma and Birifor. Akofena Varia 10(3): 437-446 (CC BY 4.0, DOAJ-indexed).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on stress/accent. Secs. 2.2 and 3.2 (pp. 439, 442) report Kedrebéogo 1989: 83-84: Samoma long vowels are two vowel phonemes 'of the same tone'; /V1V1/ 'is able to wear a low-amount modulated tone, which is impossible for the case of short vowels' (bìí 'child', bàá 'father', bɔ̀ɔ́ 'envy', tʋ̀ʋ́ 'corpse'); analysis unit is the phonological word. 'prosodic' used only of vowel length.

sources.citation: Brindle, Jonathan. 2017. A dictionary and grammatical outline of Chakali. Berlin: Language Science Press (langsci 74).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Samoma prosody; p.264 fn.4 cites 'Kedrebéogo 1997: 100' for a disyllabic (bije-type) reading of Vi Vj sequences; bibliography entry 'Kedrebéogo, Gérard. 1997. Tone in Samona. Gur Papers/Cahiers Voltaïques (2)'.

sources.citation: Kẽdrebéogo, Gérard & Zakaria Yago. 1986 (May). Langues du Burkina Faso: les langues gurunsi. Ouagadougou: MESRS/CNRST, IRSSH & ACCT. 59 scanned pp. (archive.org item burkina-gurunsi).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent. p.3 places 'le sàmoma, plus connu sous l'hétéronyme kalemse (pluriel de Kalenga)' in northern Toéni (Sourou) and in the western Gurunsi sub-group; 139-item comparative wordlists (Kasim, Nuni, Lyele, Pana, Samoma, Sisala, Wunyema, Puu) in phonetic transcription with tone diacritics; 'Renseignements phonétiques' is only about transliteration symbols. Samoma bibliography p.56 lists Oudet 1978/s.d. mss and Kedrebéogo 1984.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page kala1383 (Hammarström et al.), with langdoc search for Kedrebéogo (10 records) and archive.org / DOAJ / Google Books feed / Wikipedia (en, fr) / IRD Horizon records.
sources.note: No phonological content; Wikipedia is a stub ('Kalamsé, or Sàmòmá, is a Gur language of Burkina Faso and Mali'). DOAJ 'Samoma' = 1 hit (Tirogo & Soubeiga 2023); archive.org = the 1986 wordlist volume only.
